title: Robots of Robin
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC Asia-India Finals Mirror Contest 2016
statement: Robin is a robot builder. His robots are specialized to do only one thing: move from A to B. Today he's testing out the three new robots he has just built. The testing will happen in an **R × C** rectangular grid. Some of the cells will be empty, and the remaining cells will contain obstacles.
